premises.batch_max_questions.description: Most questions in one premise batch for Daniel (plan v3 §8.6); scripts/premises list writes the next batch from the open premises of the blocking radii.

premises.blocking_radii.description: Radii whose unsettled premise refuses a Premises: line that cites it (veto V0).

premises.default_radius.description: Radius of a proposed premise whose reasons reach nothing larger.

premises.digest_algorithm.description: hashlib algorithm of the dependents seal and of event ids.

premises.duplicate_min_score.description: Similarity (0-1) from which scripts/premises propose refuses a statement as a duplicate of an existing premise.

premises.event_schema_dir.description: Directory of the event payload schemas, <type>.v<version>.json.

premises.event_version.description: Version of the premise.* event payloads written.

premises.find_min_score.description: Similarity (0-1) from which scripts/premises find lists an existing premise.

premises.find_min_token_length.description: Shortest word that counts when two statements are compared.

premises.high_blast_unit_share_percent.description: Share of the active units a premise must reach for its computed radius to be the largest one (plan v3 §8.5); applied when the active unit count is known (scripts/premises propose --active-units, until the U0 manifests exist).

premises.high_reason_kinds.description: Blast reason kinds (<kind>:<target>) that make the computed radius the largest one: a decision or veto, or something costly to undo.

premises.id_min_digits.description: Minimum digits of a premise id number (P-00).

premises.index_dir.description: Directory, ignored by git, where scripts/premises list writes the index by default (P-10).

premises.index_file.description: Name of the index scripts/premises list writes on demand; never committed anywhere in the repository (P-10), and structure-check refuses a tracked one.

premises.line_name.description: Name of the body line that lists the premises a plan or PR depends on, next to the B5 trailers.

premises.measured_statuses.description: Statuses whose answer needs the measurement's evidence (answer.evidence).

premises.medium_min_units.description: Units a premise must reach for its computed radius to be at least medium.

premises.medium_reason_kinds.description: Blast reason kinds that make the computed radius at least medium (a lane's plan, a cell).

premises.missing_line_fails.description: v1 switch of D-066: when true a PR body without a Premises: line fails structure-check; in v0 it is a warning.

premises.none_token.description: Value of a Premises: line that depends on no premise.

premises.open_statuses.description: Statuses of a premise without an answer.

premises.plan_globs.description: Tracked files scanned for Premises: lines when the blast of a premise is computed.

premises.producer.description: Producer name in the event envelope; it must match the envelope's producer pattern (contracts/events/envelope.v1.json), or every reader of the repository channel would quarantine the event (ENV-FIX-PREMISE-BLAST).

premises.quote_required_statuses.description: Settled statuses that need a non-empty literal quote in the answer before a Premises: line may rely on them, and before scripts/premises answer records them (D-069 item 10). Without the quote a cited premise is treated as unsettled: a blocking radius fails, a warning radius warns.

premises.quoted_statuses.description: Statuses whose answer needs a literal quote or a link to the message (answer.quote or answer.where); a paraphrase stays inferred.

premises.radii.description: Radius names, from the smallest to the largest blast. A computed radius may be raised by hand, never lowered.

premises.record_schema.description: JSON Schema 2020-12 of a premise record.

premises.record_suffix.description: File suffix of a premise record.

premises.refused_statuses.description: Statuses a Premises: line may not cite (unless the PR records that premise).

premises.register_dir.description: Directory of the premise register: one record per premise, named <slug> plus premises.record_suffix (D-066).

premises.settled_statuses.description: Statuses that settle a premise, so citing it never blocks.

premises.unit_reason_kind.description: Blast reason kind that names one unit; premises.medium_min_units of them make the radius medium.

premises.unquoted_grandfathered.description: Premise ids confirmed before the quote rule (answer has a link, no quote). Shrink-only: remove an id when its quote is recorded; never add one.

premises.warning_radii.description: Radii whose unsettled premise only warns when cited; the other radii are only counted.
